data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek finally returns to flyweight as Di Bella gets Samurai 4 wish
data.description: Superlek will return to flyweight for the first time in nearly three years to defend his ONE Championship kickboxing world title against Jonathan Di Bella in Tokyo.

data.title: South Africa coach Erasmus wary of struggling Argentina
data.description: BUENOS AIRES — South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus insists the world champions face a "massive challenge" against Argentina on Saturday despite the recent poor form of their opponents.

data.title: SAT chief says U23s, spikers can deliver
data.description: Thailand's U23 football team will make a run into the later stages of the 20th Asian Games while the women's volleyball players will bring home a medal.

data.title: ONE Championship: Dayakaev makes weight with ease before tense Superlek face-off
data.description: Abdulla Dayakaev and Superlek both made weight for their ONE Championship rematch on Friday – before going chest to chest in a tense final face-off in Bangkok.

data.title: Hudson targets perfect finish
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson believes having his players rested and fully fit after a tough away game against the Philippines will be crucial as the War Elephants prepare to take on Myanmar in the final Group B match of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday.

data.title: UEFA says boycott of World Cups stands despite FIFA backdown on private investment
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - European football's governing body UEFA said they would maintain their boycott of the men's and women's World Cups on Thursday despite FIFA withdrawing the plan to open up their competitions to private investment.

data.title: Police raid South Korean FA as World Cup fallout continues
data.description: SEOUL - Police raided South Korea’s football association on Thursday as part of an investigation into the appointment of the coach in charge during their dismal World Cup campaign.

data.title: ONE Championship: Phetjeeja to defend kickboxing title against newcomer Antonia Prifti, source says
data.description: ONE Championship women's atomweight kickboxing champion Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom will defend her belt against newly signed Greek star Antonia Prifti at The Inner Circle 28, the Bangkok Post understands.

data.title: Back to the future as champion Springboks host All Blacks
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - Hosts South Africa and visitors New Zealand are going back to the future with a rugby tour that begins in Cape Town on Friday and ends 12,700 kilometres away in the United States.

data.title: Villa coast past BG for another Asian win
data.description: Aston Villa continued their Asian pre‑season tour with a composed 3‑1 victory over BG Pathum United in Bangkok, the Europa League holders showing their quality despite a rain‑soaked delay that pushed kick‑off back by 45 minutes.

data.title: Thais on the march in the Philippines
data.description: Thailand edged closer to the semi‑finals of the Asean Hyundai Cup with a late strike from Waris Choolthong that secured a 1‑0 victory over the Philippines in New Clark City on Tuesday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex faces Selina Flores next as Chatri warns MMA return must wait
data.description: Stamp Fairtex will face Selina Flores next month at ONE Fight Night 47 in Bangkok – after Chatri Sityodtong urged the Thai superstar to continue rebuilding her confidence through striking before returning to MMA.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri guarantees Ghazali vs Ondash rematch ‘100 per cent’ – says ‘Jojo won’
data.description: ONE Championship boss Chatri Sityodtong has guaranteed Johan Ghazali another opportunity to face Ramadan Ondash – despite the Lebanese teenager’s public refusal to grant an immediate rematch.

data.title: South Korea pro baseball league cancels games over heatwave
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's professional baseball league cancelled all games scheduled for Wednesday and Thursday amid a record-setting heatwave that has sent spectators to hospital.

data.title: Sirimongkol shows no sign of ageing
data.description: About a month ago, I came across a post announcing that 49-year-old Sirimongkol Singmanasak, yes, you read that right, would face 25-year-old Kyrgyz heavyweight Nurbek Valizhonov (7-0, 7 KOs) for the vacant WBA Asia heavyweight title at World Siam Stadium on a TL Boxing Promotion card.

data.title: Teacher who conquered the greens
data.description: Graham Marsh is probably one of the most underestimated players of his generation and our paths crossed in Australia when I was hired to work at a new major golf course development that he was building. A quiet, intelligent man, he was a maths teacher before he realised that he could make more money by playing tournament golf.

data.title: Teenage Vareeraya to lead Thai bid at Asian Games
data.description: Skateboarder Vareeraya Sukasem will lead Thailand's challenge in extreme sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month after the Thailand Extreme Sports Association (Tesa) has announced a nine-member team for the continental championship.

data.title: Shot in the arm for U17 team
data.description: Thailand's under‑17 side has been handed a favourable position in Pot One for the forthcoming AFC U17 Asian Cup Uzbekistan 2027 qualifiers, underlining the country's growing stature in youth football across Asia.

data.title: Infantino’s problems mount inside and outside Fifa
data.description: PARIS - Pressure on Fifa president Gianni Infantino intensified on Tuesday, with opposition emerging from within world football’s governing body as well as from external critics over his since-abandoned proposal to open the World Cup to private investment.

data.title: Fifa denies embattled chief sought Trump’s help
data.description: Fifa on Tuesday dismissed ‌as “pure fiction” a report that its president Gianni Infantino had sought support from US President Donald Trump’s administration after the collapse of a plan to sell a stake in World Cup commercial rights.

data.title: ONE Championship: Abdallah Ondash tells Prajanchai ‘you are next’ after 19-second KO
data.description: Abdallah Ondash has told undisputed strawweight Muay Thai champion Prajanchai PK Saenchai “you are next” after delivering a 19-second knockout that strengthened his claim for a ONE Championship title opportunity.

data.title: Thailand's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team put on a strong performance in the championship decider of 2026 SEA V Cup first leg, decisively defeating hosts Vietnam 3-0 (25-18, 25-17, 25-14) in Hanoi on Sunday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Islay Bomogao asks Chatri for 105lb division after earning US$100,000 contract
data.description: Islay Erika Bomogao has asked ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong to create a new 105lb division after earning a US$100,000 contract in Bangkok.

data.title: Infantino, the FIFA president under pressure after scrapped investor plan
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino's ability to brush aside criticism and push through enlarged versions of the Club World Cup and World Cup lent him an air of omnipotence, but a failed private investor plan has left his position under threat for the first time.

data.title: Atiruj ends long wait with Pattaya triumph
data.description: Atiruj Winaicharoenchai finally claimed the title he had coveted for nearly a decade, edging home by a single stroke to win the Singha Pattaya Open at Laem Chabang International Country Club on Sunday.

data.title: Villa roll into city to play BG
data.description: Fresh from their Europa League triumph, Aston Villa continue their Asian pre‑season tour tonight with a meeting against Thai Premier League side BG Pathum United at True BG Stadium.

data.title: Kingdom's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team put on a strong performance in the championship decider of 2026 SEA V Cup first leg, decisively defeating hosts Vietnam 3-0 (25-18, 25-17, 25-14) in Hanoi on Sunday night.
